---
title: Explore universe
jupyter: python3
---

Exploring the processed universe data:

- `data/interim/universe.parquet`: dynamic top-50 S&P500 universe per quarter, one row per PermID; columns `quarter_end`, `ric`, `permid`, `ticker`, `delisted`, `marketcap`, `rank` (see `src/factor_weaver/data/build/universe.py`)

Membership is reconstructed backwards from the current S&P500 snapshot using joiner/leaver events, deduplicated by PermID, and ranked by as-of market cap. Delisted RICs have no LSEG ticker; their ticker is the base RIC symbol (e.g. TWX) and `delisted=True`.

```{python}
import os
import duckdb
from pathlib import Path

while not (Path.cwd() / "config" / "data.yaml").exists() and Path.cwd().parent != Path.cwd():
    os.chdir("..")
print(Path.cwd())
```

### Sample

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
select * from 'data/interim/universe.parquet' limit 10
""")
```

### Distinct permids / rics / tickers

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
select count(distinct permid), count(distinct ric), count(distinct ticker)
from 'data/interim/universe.parquet'
""")
```

### Delisted permids

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
select delisted, count(distinct permid) as permids
from 'data/interim/universe.parquet'
group by delisted
""")
```

### Tickers shared by several permids

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
select ticker, array_agg(distinct permid) as permids, array_agg(distinct ric) as rics
from 'data/interim/universe.parquet'
group by ticker
having count(distinct permid) > 1
order by ticker
""")
```

### Quarters per permid

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
select permid, any_value(ticker) as ticker, count(*) as quarters
from 'data/interim/universe.parquet'
group by permid
order by quarters desc
""")
```
